atoms.text:
Scrolling, scrolling ... Through the screen of sleepless nights, notifications ping and buzz and boom like thunder in our thumbs — Does anyone remember silence?

Scrolling, scrolling ... We chase the likes, the hearts, the shares that simmer like fool's gold in our palms, collecting friends like coins — ten thousand strong, yet sitting all alone.

Scrolling, scrolling ... The screen reflects our faces, pale and haunting, blue light baptising us in artificial dawn while real sunrises slip away unseen.

In this connection? We speak in symbols and think in hashtags﻿ — the irony cuts deep: we're more connected yet more isolated than ever before.
